fields.Name: IT147 - Optimistic Concurrency over GraphQL
fields.Description: Two independent GraphQL sessions of one user edit the same MJ: User Settings row. CC1 a stale overlapping save is refused with a conflict message naming the field and the stored value is untouched; CC2 a stale save that converges on the stored value is accepted; CC3 a stale save on a different column is accepted and the other session's column survives; CC4 the saving session's entity carries the merged row after the save; CC5 a refused two-field save writes neither field. Mutating; self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The server rejects only genuinely conflicting stale saves, merges non-overlapping ones, and the client entity reflects the merged row.
